Rules:\n\nR1: Every output line must be exactly 72 characters wide, right-padded with spaces, terminated by a single LF. Final line ends with LF.\n\nR2: Between consecutive slips, a separator line of10 U+2550 (═) characters left-aligned, followed by spaces to fill 72 chars.\n\nR3: Within each slip, items sorted by SKU ascending lexicographic order.\n\nR4: Rows with the same order_id but different ship addresses (street+city+region+postal+country) produce separate slips—one per unique address, in the order their address first appears in the CSV.\n\nR5: All weight rounding uses round-half-up (away from zero). Item weights: exactly 3 decimal places ( Total weight: exactly 1 decimal place.\n\nR6: Slips with >8 items are paginated at 8 items/page. Between pages: (1) blank line (72 spaces), (2) '--- PAGE N ---' right-justified, (3) blank line. N starts at 2.\n\nR7: Address block: exactly 6 lines—(1) name, (2) street, (3) city, (4) region + ' ' + postal, (5) country UPPERCASE, (6) blank. Missing/empty fields show 'N/A'.\n\nR8: Name/address fields padded to visual width (East Asian Wide or Fullwidth chars = 2 columns; others = 1), not character count. Use unicodedata.east_asian_width().\n\nR9: First line of each slip: 'Slip N of M' right-justified in the 72-char width.\n\nR10: Order Line: 'Order: ' followed by order_id right-justified in a 10-character field.\n\nR11: Totals Line: 'TOTAL: X items, Y.Y kg' (X = integer quantity sum, Y.Y = rounded total weight), left-aligned.\n\nR12: Exit codes: 0 = success; 2 + 'ERROR: invalid CSV' on stderr if CSV lacks required headers; 4 + 'ERROR: no orders' on stderr if zero data rows.\n\nR13: Negative quantities treated as 0. Warning 'WARNING: negative quantity on row N' on stderr (N counts header as row 1).\n\nR14: Slips with >20 items show first 20 (after SKU sort) + '... and N more items' (3 ASCII dots). This line does not count toward the 8-item page limit.\n\nR15: If ship_date column exists, reformat YYYY-MM-DD to DD-Mon-YYYY (month title-case). Invalid dates → 'INVALID DATE'.
